payout_quote: Referring member and referred member will each receive $50.00 for each referral that results in a new membership being opened during promotional runtime.
steps: Be an Old Hickory Credit Union member
Tell a friend why you love OHCU and invite them to join
Friend provides your name and address at sign-up
Once their new membership is opened, you and your friend each receive $50
catches: Friend must be new to OHCU (no accounts in the last 120 days)
Friend must provide your name and address at sign-up
Paid per new membership opened during the promotional runtime; credit union reserves the right to extend, alter, modify, or cancel the promotion at any time
Bonuses are subject to IRS reporting requirements; recipients are responsible for income tax reporting
biggest_catch: $50 each is solid — but your friend must be truly new (no OHCU account in the last 120 days) and they must give your name and address at sign-up.
eligibility: Old Hickory Credit Union members; referred friends must be new to OHCU (no accounts in last 120 days)
timing: Paid per new membership opened during promotional runtime
